blocks.text: SAN ILDEFONSO, Ilocos Sur, Philippines – Police arrested a 47-year-old barangay councilor classified as a high-value suspect after serving search warrants for allegedly violating anti-drug and firearms laws in Barangay San Lucas, Magsingal, Ilocos Sur, on Friday, Nov. 20. According to Capt. Melvin Trinidad, officer-in-charge of the Magsingal Municipal Police Station, the Ilocos Sur Provincial Intelligence Unit led the operation. Authorities implemented two search warrants against the suspect: one for violating the he Comprehensive Dangerous Drugs Act and another for violating the Comprehensive Firearms and Ammunition Regulation Act.
